Hello! Great effort on your Warrior One pose! I can see you're really working hard. Let me help you refine a few things to get the most benefit from this powerful posture.

First, let's focus on your **spine**. I notice it's not quite straight right now. Think about lengthening up through your torso, drawing your navel gently in, and stacking your ribs over your hips. Imagine a string pulling the crown of your head toward the ceiling. This alignment will help you find strength and stability in the pose.

Next, let's look at your **arms**. They're not fully extended upward at the moment. Try to straighten your elbows and reach actively through your fingertips toward the sky. Your shoulders should stay relaxed and down away from your ears while your arms create that beautiful straight line of energy upward.

Finally, and this is really important for protecting your knee, I notice your **front knee isn't positioned directly over your ankle**. Let's adjust that by either bringing your knee back or stepping your foot forward until your knee stacks right above your ankle. This creates a safe 90-degree angle and helps you build strength properly while protecting your joints.

Take a moment to make these adjustments. There's no rush—yoga is a practice, and these refinements will come naturally with time. You're doing wonderfully, and these small changes will make a big difference in how the pose feels. Keep breathing!
